user.title: Samsung Soundbar
user.description: Turn on IP control first: SmartThings app → your soundbar → ⋮ → Settings → IP control.

data_description.host: IP address of the soundbar. Give it a fixed address (DHCP reservation) in your router.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the soundbar. Check the IP address and that IP control is on in the SmartThings app.

abort.cannot_connect: Can't reach the soundbar. Check that IP control is on in the SmartThings app.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different soundbar.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the soundbar's state. Changes made with its own remote or through the TV show up within this time.

command_failed.message: The soundbar didn't carry out the command: {error}

sound_mode_not_supported.message: This soundbar doesn't support the {sound_mode} sound mode, so it has been removed from the list.
